These features are more typical of a lower-grade IDH-mutant glioma than an IDH-wildtype glioblastoma phenotype. The main counterpoint is that temporal location can be seen in IDH-wildtype glioblastoma, but the absence of enhancement, necrosis, infiltrative deep extension, and major mass effect weighs against that interpretation. On balance, the MRI metadata supports IDH-mutant status.

overall_comment: MRI-only molecular subtyping is uncertain, especially for 1p/19q status. DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, and susceptibility/calcification-sensitive imaging were not available.
